ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: We haven't been to the church much recently, have we? Maybe we should drop by every once in a while...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Мы в последнее время редко бывали в церкви, правда? Может, стоит иногда заглядывать...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Yeah, maybe. There might be something fun going on...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Ага, может быть. Вдруг там что-то интересное...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Very well. I think I can allow that. But you have to keep your duties as a nun too. Understood?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Хорошо. Думаю, я могу это позволить. Но свои обязанности монахини ты тоже должна выполнять. Поняла?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Of course, I understand. I'll do my very best!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hey, Pamela! It's been a while!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: My, if it isn't Lydie and Sue? Nice to see you again!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Боже мой, да это же Лиди и Сью? Рада вас видеть снова!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: You've been gone a while. What have you been doing?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Тебя давно не было. Чем ты занималась?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: I've been looking for items for my shop. I want to sell as many as I can!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Искала товары для своего магазина. Хочу продать как можно больше!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: I see. You'll be running a shop here again?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Понятно. Значит, снова будешь вести здесь магазин?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hahaha, opening a shop in a church! You're a bold one, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, открыть магазин в церкви! Ты смелая, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: It's fine. I've got my reasons, and so I'm sure God will forgive me.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Всё в порядке. У меня есть причины — уверена, Бог меня простит.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: That sounds a bit suspicious to me! What do you think, Sister Grace?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Для меня это звучит немного подозрительно! Что скажешь, сестра Грейс?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Just like she said, there are reasons for this. She has my permission.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Как она и сказала, на то есть причины. У неё есть моё разрешение.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: That's right. My shop is approved by the church!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Ahem. I don't think we should go quite that far.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Хм. Думаю, так далеко заходить не стоит.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Really? Well, in any case, welcome to my grand re-opening!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Правда? Ну, в любом случае — добро пожаловать на моё торжественное открытие!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hehehe, go ahead, girls! Take a good look around!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hmmm. You've been to Merveille in the past, haven't you, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хм. Ты ведь уже бывала в Мервейле раньше, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Yes, that's right. I trained here as a nun.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Да, верно. Я здесь проходила обучение как монахиня.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hehe, you were so small back then! This small! Ah, that takes me back!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хе-хе, вы тогда были такими крошками! Вот такими! Ах, как давно это было!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Haha, I don't think we were quite that small!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ха-ха, мы вряд ли были настолько крошечными!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: When you finished, though, didn't you leave in a carriage?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: А когда ты закончила, разве не уехала в карете?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: So why did you come back to Merveille? After all this time, too...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Так почему же ты вернулась в Мервейль? И после стольких лет...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hmm. Do you really want to know?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хм. Вам и правда интересно?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Yes, of course.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Да, конечно.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: All right. Have your handkerchiefs ready, though, girls.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хорошо. Только приготовьте платочки, девочки.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: It was after I finished my training. I stopped in a large town on my way home.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Это было после окончания обучения. По пути домой я остановилась в большом городе.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: I was buying some gifts, and went and spent too much money! I couldn't pay for the rest of the journey!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Покупала подарки — и потратила слишком много! Не хватило на остаток пути!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Ugh...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ух...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: But I wasn't going to give up! I earned enough money for a ticket, got another carriage...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Но я не сдалась! Заработала на билет, села в другую карету...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: But this time it was the wrong carriage! So I turned up back here!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Но на этот раз — не в ту! И оказалась снова здесь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: I see... That's just like you, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Понятно... Это так на тебя похоже, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Ah. So the reason for this new shop...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ах. Значит, причина нового магазина...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: That's right! To make the cash to get me back home!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Верно! Заработать на дорогу домой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Well, that's a better reason than I expected. I thought maybe you were just passing the time!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Что ж, причина весомее, чем я ожидала. Я думала, ты просто коротаешь время!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Please! Sue, that's quite rude!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Прошу тебя! Сью, это довольно грубо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: This is about more than just passing the time! Finding products, managing sales, it isn't easy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Это куда больше, чем просто коротать время! Искать товар, вести продажи — это непросто!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hahaha, I guess you're right.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха, наверное, ты права.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: So please, think of it as helping me out, and buy a lot of things from me! Thank you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Поэтому, пожалуйста, считайте, что помогаете мне, и покупайте у меня побольше! Спасибо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Seriously! What are you playing at, Ines?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Серьёзно! Во что ты играешь, Инес?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Uwah! I'm sorry!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ух! Прости!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: W-What's going on here?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ч-что здесь происходит?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hey, girls. Ines broke a goblet used in our services.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Эй, девочки. Инес разбила кубок, которым пользуются на службах.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: I'm sorry. My hand just slipped!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Прости. Рука просто соскользнула!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Just? You need to be more responsible!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: «Просто»? Тебе нужно быть ответственнее!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: I think that's enough, Chloe. No need to be so hard on her!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Думаю, хватит, Хлоя. Не надо быть с ней такой строгой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes. No need to get vindictive!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Каждый иногда ошибается. Не стоит злиться на неё за это!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Sister Pamela... But...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Сестра Памела... Но...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hehe, it's all right. Lydie and Sue here will make us another goblet, won't you girls?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хе-хе, всё хорошо. Лиди и Сью сделают нам новый кубок, правда, девочки?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: That's right! We can whip up one of those in... hold on, us?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Верно! Мы мигом сделаем такой... погоди, мы?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Why are you pushing this on to us?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Зачем ты это на нас сваливаешь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Oh? You don't want to help?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ой? Не хотите помочь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Ah, those sparkling eyes! That's a low blow!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ах, эти сверкающие глаза! Удар ниже пояса!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Fine! Fine! We'll make this goblet, if we must!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ладно! Ладно! Сделаем этот кубок, раз надо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: So please, Chloe, don't make things any harder on Ines.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, Хлоя, не усложняй жизнь Инес.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Fine, I won't. If that's what all of you think.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хорошо, не буду. Раз вы все так думаете.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Looks like you're off the hook, Ines.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Похоже, ты выкрутилась, Инес.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: That's right!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Точно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: All right! Please go ahead and make the goblet!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Отлично! Пожалуйста, сделайте кубок!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hehe!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хе-хе!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah, what a lovely goblet! Thank you, both of you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах, какой чудесный кубок! Спасибо вам обеим!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Let me thank you too! You really saved me, Lydie, Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Позвольте и мне поблагодарить! Вы меня и правда спасли, Лиди, Сью!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: They've made this lovely new goblet, so be sure not to break it again, understand?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Они сделали этот прекрасный новый кубок, так что больше не разбей его, поняла?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm sorry for being so hard on you before.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Прости, что раньше была с тобой такой строгой.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Thank you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Спасибо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Uwah, hey! No hugging on church grounds!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ух, эй! Никаких объятий на территории церкви!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm so happy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Я так счастлива!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hehehe!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Thank goodness for that. Another case closed!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Слава богу. Ещё одно дело закрыто!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: It looks that way.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Похоже на то.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah, Sister Grace! Hello!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах, сестра Грейс! Здравствуй!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hello. Pamela really is a wonderful nun, isn't she?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Здравствуйте. Памела и правда замечательная монахиня, правда?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Covering for other's failures, improving relationships while solving the issue...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Прикрывает чужие ошибки, улучшает отношения и при этом решает проблему...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: She comes across as kind of an airhead, and it can be very deceptive. But she's rather clever indeed.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Она кажется немного легкомысленной — и это очень обманчиво. А на деле довольно умна.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hahaha! It might be rude to say "actually", but actually she's very reliable!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Может, грубо говорить «на самом деле», но на самом деле она очень надёжная!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I guess so. She just comes across as not all there sometimes!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Пожалуй. Просто иногда кажется, что она немного не от мира сего!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Which is just something that makes her so special.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Что как раз и делает её такой особенной.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: What was that?! It sounds like something just broke!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Что это было?! Кажется, что-то только что разбилось!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ines! Not again!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Инес! Только не снова!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I-I-It wasn't me this time! Not me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Я-я-это была не я! Не я!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: So who... ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Тогда кто... ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Don't tell me, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Только не говори — Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hehe! Sorry!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Хе-хе! Прости!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: What?! Pamela, what just happened?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Что?! Памела, что только что случилось?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm sorry... My hand just slipped!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Прости... Рука просто соскользнула!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Maybe we can just make it stick together with something? Do you think that might work?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Может, просто склеим чем-нибудь? Как думаете, сработает?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: It makes her special, all right!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Особенная, ничего не скажешь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hahaha, yeah... That's it for our involvement in this, I think!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха, да... Думаю, на этом наше участие окончено!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hey, girls. I've got something I want to ask.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Эй, девочки. Хочу кое о чём спросить.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Is there anything that I don't have in stock that you would like to see in the shop?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Есть ли что-то, чего у меня нет в наличии, а вам хотелось бы видеть в магазине?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hmm, nothing really comes to mind... What about you, Sue?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хм, ничего особенного не приходит на ум... А тебе, Сью?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: No, nothing really... "Mom's shop" has pretty much everything we need...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Нет, ничего... В «мамином магазине» есть практически всё, что нам нужно...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: What was that? "Mom's"?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Что это было? «Мамином»?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Ah! I'm sorry! Pamela! Pamela's shop!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ах! Прости! Памела! Магазин Памелы!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hahaha! Sue, you put your foot in your mouth this time!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Сью, на этот раз ты влипла!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Uwah! I can't believe I just said that...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ух! Не могу поверить, что я это сказала...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hehe. I sort of can understand why, though...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хе-хе. Хотя я вроде как понимаю почему...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Pamela is so kind, and she smells nice too... She's like a mom.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Памела такая добрая, и от неё приятно пахнет... Она как мама.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Yeah, that's right. I've kind of thought of Pamela being very mother-like for a while now.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ага, верно. Я уже давно думаю, что Памела очень похожа на маму.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Oh my! That makes me very happy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: О боже! Это меня очень радует!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Lydie! Sue! You can call me "mom" as much as you like!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Лиди! Сью! Можете называть меня «мамой» сколько угодно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Go ahead, give it a try! Call me mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Давайте, попробуйте! Назовите меня мамой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Very well... Ahem. Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хорошо... хм. Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Mom! Ah, it sounds better than I thought.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Мама! Ах, звучит лучше, чем я думала.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: I'm right here, girls! Yes, I quite like the sound of that!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Я здесь, девочки! Да, мне очень нравится, как это звучит!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Maybe we'll call you mom every now and then?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Может, будем иногда называть тебя мамой?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Say, Mommy dearest... Can you also give us a discount?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Скажи, мамочка дорогая... А можешь сделать нам скидку?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hehehe! Not a chance!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Ни за что!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Ah, I've got one question. What's your hometown like, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ах, один вопрос. Какой твой родной город, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: It's a long way from here. Everyone is so kind, though, it's a lovely place!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Далеко отсюда. Но все там такие добрые — чудесное место!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Wow. A place just like you, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ух ты. Место совсем как ты, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Uwah, Lydie! We don't usually compare people and places, do we?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ух, Лиди! Мы обычно не сравниваем людей и места, правда?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Haha, I was just trying something out. I bet it is a wonderful place, though.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ха-ха, я просто попробовала. Но уверена, это чудесное место.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Well, I haven't been back for a long time. Five years? Ten? Something like that.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ну, я давно не возвращалась. Пять лет? Десять? Что-то вроде того.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Hold on... Sorry if I'm being rude, but how old are you, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Погоди... Извини, если грубо, но сколько тебе лет, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Thinking about it now, you don't seem to have changed at all from when we first met you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Если подумать, ты совсем не изменилась с тех пор, как мы впервые тебя встретили!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Good point! Are you the same age as Sister Grace?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Верно! Ты одного возраста с сестрой Грейс?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Hahaha, I didn't think so. Sister Grace looks young, but she's in her 50s...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я так и думала. Сестра Грейс выглядит молодо, но ей уже за пятьдесят...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: I'm much, much older than Grace. I guess I'm 200? 300?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Я намного-намного старше Грейс. Кажется, мне двести? Триста?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: ...Huh? Could you say that one more time, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: ...А? Не могла бы ты сказать это ещё раз, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Pamela, sorry... I can borrow you for a moment?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Памела, прости... Можно тебя на минутку?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Yes, of course. Sorry girls, we'll have to pick this up another time.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Да, конечно. Простите, девочки, продолжим в другой раз.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: She said 300, but she was just joking, right?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Она сказала «триста», но это же шутка, правда?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: H-Has to be... A joke! Just a joke! Hahaha!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Д-должна быть... Шутка! Просто шутка! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwah, I did it again...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ух, я снова это сделала...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Are you alright, Lydie? It's been a while since you failed so badly!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ты в порядке, Лиди? Давненько ты так сильно не проваливалась!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Yeah... That thing Pamela said has been on my mind.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ага... То, что сказала Памела, не выходит из головы.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: What, about being 300 years old? Hahaha, that was just a Pamela-style joke!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ты про триста лет? Ха-ха-ха, это просто шутка в стиле Памелы!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: She came out with it really smoothly, for it to be a joke... Maybe Pamela is actually a ghost?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Она сказала это так спокойно для шутки... Может, Памела на самом деле призрак?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: No, that can't be. It can't!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Нет, не может быть. Не может!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Maybe, it could?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: А может, и может?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwaaaaah! P-P-P-Pamela! W-What are you doing here?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Аааа! П-п-п-Памела! Ч-что ты здесь делаешь?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: I didn't hear the door open! Did you come in through the window?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Я не слышала, как открылась дверь! Ты влезла через окно?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: No, I came through the door. Quite literally through it! Wooooh!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Нет, я вошла через дверь. Буквально сквозь неё! Ууууу!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwah! So you really are a g-g-g-g...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Аааа! Так ты и правда п-п-п-п...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: That's right! I'm a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Верно! Я призрак!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Howah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ой-мамочки!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Sue! Come back to us!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Сью! Вернись к нам!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Oh my... I just wanted to get some more ink?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: О боже... Я просто хотела взять ещё чернил?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: I'll leave the papers here... I hope you can take care of it for me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Оставлю бумаги здесь... Надеюсь, вы ими займётесь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Aaaaaaah, don't look! Don't look! She ghosted her way out of here again! Noooooo!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Аааааа, не смотрю! Не смотрю! Она снова ускользнула отсюда призраком! Неееееет!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Calm down! It's okay, calm down! Everything is okay!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Успокойся! Всё хорошо, успокойся! Всё в порядке!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwaaaah! I can't take any more! I can't believeeeee anything any moooooore!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Аааа! Больше не могу! Я ни во что больше не веееерю!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Sue! You can believe in me! Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Сью! Ты можешь верить в меня! Сью!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Pamela? Here's the ink you asked for.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Памела? Вот чернила, которые ты просила.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Hehehe, thank you. Now I can make some new products!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе, спасибо. Теперь я смогу делать новые товары!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Why is Sue hiding behind you like that?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Почему Сью так прячется за тобой?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: A g-g-g-ghost! I'm scared of ghosts! I'm scared of Pamela being a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: П-п-п-призрак! Я боюсь привидений! Боюсь, что Памела — призрак!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Is it true, what you said before? That you're a ghost?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Это правда, что ты говорила раньше? Что ты призрак?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Yes, it's true! I'm a real ghost, 100%!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Да, правда! Я настоящий призрак, на все сто!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Oh dear, has Sue been triggered again? It's alright, it's all fine!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Ох, у Сью опять паника? Всё хорошо, всё в порядке!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Hmmm... This might be a problem.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: If you're so scared of me already... What would happen if I really tried to scare you...?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Если ты уже так меня боишься... Что будет, если я и правда попробую тебя напугать...?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Gyaaaah! Nooo! I understand! I'm not scared anymore! Don't scare me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Ааааа! Нееет! Поняла! Я больше не боюсь! Не пугай меня!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Good. There's nothing to fear. La-la-la!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Aaaah! I'm not scared... I'm not! Pamela is still Pamela! Pam-Pam-Pam-Pam...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Аааа! Я не боюсь... Не боюсь! Памела всё ещё Памела! Пам-Пам-Пам-Пам...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Ghosts seem to be more common than I expected. I'll need to remember this.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Призраки, кажется, встречаются чаще, чем я думала. Надо это запомнить.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Pamela! We're here to check if ghosts really don't have legs...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Памела! Мы здесь, чтобы проверить, правда ли у призраков нет ног...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: You are more than qualified. Please, Pamela.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Ты более чем подходишь. Пожалуйста, Памела.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Will you become Head Sister, and lead this church into an even better future?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Станешь ли ты старшей сестрой и поведёшь эту церковь к ещё лучшему будущему?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: H-Head Sister? I wonder what Pamela will do?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: С-старшая сестра? Интересно, что скажет Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Спасибо за предложение, но я не могу принять...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Why? I know you're perfect for this!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Почему? Я знаю, ты идеально для этого подходишь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: No, I don't agree. I'm sure you can do a much better job, Grace!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Нет, я не согласна. Уверена, ты справишься гораздо лучше, Грейс!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Look at Chloe, at Ines. Everyone holds you in such high regard, Grace!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Посмотри на Хлою, на Инес. Все так высоко тебя ценят, Грейс!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: So, please, you should remain the Head Sister. All right?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, оставайся старшей сестрой. Хорошо?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: I see... In which case, very well. I won't say any more about it.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Понятно... Тогда ладно. Больше не буду об этом говорить.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: But you'll still let me consult with you on the direction the church should take, of course?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Но ты всё же позволишь советоваться с тобой о направлении церкви, верно?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Of course! You can leave that to me, no problem!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Конечно! Можешь оставить это мне, без проблем!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: So she turned it down, but that was so cool.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Значит, она отказалась, но это было так круто.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Yeah! It really got me! I guess those 300 years make all the difference!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Ага! Меня это и правда зацепило! Думаю, эти триста лет решают всё!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: What? 300 years? Lydie, what are you talking about?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Что? Триста лет? Лиди, о чём ты?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Excuse me? What are YOU talking about? Remember, she told us herself? Pamela's a ghost...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Прости? О чём это ты? Помнишь, она сама сказала? Памела — призрак...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Hahaha, a ghost?! Have you been dreaming?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Sue, don't tell me... You've erased your own memory?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Сью, только не говори... Ты стёрла себе память?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Human defense mechanisms at work. Honestly, I guess Sue is better off this way!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Защитные механизмы человека в деле. Честно говоря, Сью так, наверное, и лучше!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Hold on... Hold on there!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Погодите... Погодите!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: W-What's up, Pamela? Something seems to have seriously surprised you...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ч-что случилось, Памела? Кажется, тебя что-то серьёзно удивило...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Guess what! It seems sales at my shop have reached my target figure!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Угадайте! Кажется, продажи в моём магазине достигли нужной цифры!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Wow, that's great! Congratulations!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ого, это здорово! Поздравляем!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Thank you! Hahaha! This is thanks to all of your purchases, too!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Спасибо! Ха-ха-ха! И это тоже благодаря всем вашим покупкам!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I've set aside money for gifts this time. Now I can finally go back home!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: На этот раз я отложила деньги на подарки. Теперь наконец могу вернуться домой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I see... You've made your money, so it's time to move on?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Понятно... Ты заработала — пора двигаться дальше?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Yeah. We're going to be sad!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ага. Нам будет грустно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Say, Pamela! One last time... Could we call you mom again, one last time?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Скажи, Памела! В последний раз... Можно ещё раз назвать тебя мамой?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Yes, of course!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Да, конечно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Together
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Ah! That settles it!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ах! Решено!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I'm going to become a nun who travels between both Kirchen Bell and Merveille!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Я стану монахиней, которая путешествует между Кирхенбеллом и Мервейлем!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: What?! I'm happy to hear that, but are you sure?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Что?! Я рада это слышать, но ты уверена?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: It will be exhausting, so no, I'm not, but if I get serious I should be able to manage it!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Это будет утомительно, так что нет, не совсем, но если возьмусь всерьёз — справлюсь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I'm really starting to like this place, after all. And I want to see the two of you grow up!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: В конце концов, мне и правда начинает нравиться это место. И я хочу увидеть, как вы двое вырастете!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: So I'm going to use all my powers and just fly there and back!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Так что я использую все свои силы и просто буду летать туда и обратно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Ah, of course! You can fly because you're a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ах, конечно! Ты умеешь летать, потому что ты призрак!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Fly?... A ghost?... H-Hold on... Scaring... I feel like I'm about to remember something...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Летать?... Призрак?... П-погоди... Страшно... Такое ощущение, будто я вот-вот что-то вспомню...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Uwaah! Uwaaaaaaaaah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Уваа! Увааааааа!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Kyaah, Sue! Are you okay?! Water, get some water!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Кьяа, Сью! Ты в порядке?! Воды, принесите воды!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Hmm... What should I do with all the money I've made, though?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Хм... Но что мне делать со всеми заработанными деньгами?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Buy lots of gifts, I guess! Hmm, what would be best?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Наверное, накупить подарков! Хм, что лучше взять?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I hope everyone in Kirchen Bell is doing well!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Надеюсь, у всех в Кирхенбелле всё хорошо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: A ghost... I can't take this... Pamela is scary. Mom is a ghost. I want to like her, but...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Призрак... Не вынесу... Памела пугает. Мама — призрак. Хочу её любить, но...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Someone! Anyone! Sue! Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Кто-нибудь! Кто угодно! Сью! Сью!
